integrity: The proof gives a sharp minimax result and a uniqueness threshold for all stated parameters. The finite exact-rational checker is corroborative rather than a universal certificate. Scientific history and priority cannot be certified exhaustive.
limitations: Scalar real-linear simultaneous extensions from finite equilateral clusters to one point at a common radius; no arbitrary Banach-valued targets or unequal new-point radii. The optimum is established analytically; independent mathematical review remains unperformed and an unindexed equivalent in optimal transport literature is a priority risk.
title: A harmonic-deficit law for one-point linear Lipschitz extension over clustered metrics
